snippet.title: ‘Save My Scrap’Coming to Steam on April 22! Console release dates confirmed!
snippet.description:
Indie game publishing brand "AMATA Games" is pleased to announce that the Steam version of Save My Scrap, an adventure puzzle game where you repair broken androids, will be released on April 22.

In addition, the Nintendo Switch and PlayStation5 versions are scheduled to launch on April 30, followed by the Xbox Series X|S version on May 28!

◆Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4078210/Save_My_Scrap/
